definitions.action: the process of doing something to achieve an aim.
definitions.adit: an access or drainage passage leading horizontally into a mine.
definitions.bait: food used to entice fish or other animals as prey.
definitions.bandicoot: a mainly insectivorous marsupial native to Australia and New Guinea.
definitions.bandit: a violent robber or outlaw belonging to a gang.
definitions.baton: a thin stick used by a conductor to direct an orchestra or choir.
definitions.biota: the animal and plant life of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.
definitions.boat: a small vessel propelled by oars, sails, or an engine.
definitions.boot: a sturdy item of footwear covering the foot and ankle, and sometimes the lower leg.
definitions.canto: each of the sections into which some long poems are divided.
definitions.cation: a positively charged ion. The opposite of anion.
definitions.coat: a full-length outer garment with sleeves.
definitions.dint: an impression or hollow in a surface.
definitions.into: expressing motion or direction to a point on or within.
definitions.iota: the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet (Ι, ι), transliterated as ‘i’.
definitions.onto: moving to a location on (the surface of something).
definitions.taboo: a social or religious custom placing prohibition or restriction on a particular thing or person.
definitions.taco: a Mexican dish consisting of a folded tortilla filled with spicy meat or beans.
definitions.toad: a tailless amphibian with a short stout body and short legs, typically having dry warty skin that can exude poison.
definitions.tonic: a medicinal substance taken to give a feeling of vigour or well-being.
